title: PSK at SemEval-2026 Task 9: Multilingual Polarization Detection Using Ensemble Gemma Models with Synthetic Data Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the macro-F1 score of an ensemble classification system trained to detect political polarization, vilification, and stereotyping in multilingual social media text.
Evaluating model classification performance in detecting racial and ethnic polarization, stereotyping, and dehumanization across 22 languages.
Evaluating the classification system's ability to detect religious intolerance, stereotyping, and polarization in social media datasets.
Measuring the classifier's performance on identifying polarization and stereotyping directed at gender and sexual identities.
Evaluating the detection of polarization and stereotyping related to social class in social media text.
Evaluating the detection of 'us-vs-them' mentality and polarization concerning international relations and distinct cultures/nationalities.
